answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an umber bet on surviving 111 epochs of grading, and every nadir settlement recomputes the haven schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 111 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
